newsitem.title: CHINA: China forex reserves $98.8 bln at end Oct - paper.
newsitem.headline: China forex reserves $98.8 bln at end Oct - paper.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves stood at $98.8 billion at the end of October, the official China Securities newspaper on Saturday quoted the central bank as saying.
China previously reported foreign exchange reserves of $95 billion at the end of September.
Officials have said reserves could top $100 billion by the end of 1996.
The scale of China's foreign debt was appropriate, the China Securities quoted Yin Jieyan, vice president of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, as saying.
China had the ability to pay off its foreign debt on time and there was no chance of a debt crisis in China, Yin said.
